trial_court: XV Additional City Civil & Sessions Judge at Bangalore City (CCH.No.3) OS No.645/2010

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Smt.Yellamma, Smt.Bhuvaneshwari, Smt.N.Manjula (wife, daughters and plaintiff)
parties.respondent_defendant: N.Purushotham, N.Kausal Ram (sons of deceased Narayanaswamy and defendants)

facts_of_case: Suit for partition and separate possession of 3/5th share in the suit property by metes and bounds.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the defendants to prove that they are the legal heirs of Narayanaswamy and entitled to the suit property.
legal_principles.held: After framing of issues, this court proceeds to answer above issues as under: ISSUE No.2 : In the affirmative.

legal_principles.principle: The suit property devolves upon the legal heirs of Narayanaswamy after his death.
legal_principles.held: After the death of Jayamma, suit property has devolved upon her husband -Narayanaswamy, as he was the only legal heir of deceased Smt.Jayamma.

legal_principles.principle: The court will consider the welfare of the children in deciding partition and separate possession.
legal_principles.held: To protect the interest of 1st plaintiff, plaintiff No.2 and 3 have approached the defendants and requested them to effect partition in the suit properties and give the share of plaintiffs.

outcome.final_order: The court granted the relief claimed by the plaintiffs, ordering a partition and separate possession of the suit property.

use_for_drafting: drafting a petition for partition and separate possession
assisting in a joint family settlement
